title: Decoupled Class-II Nelson bound with spatial PSD backgrounds
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 q^-4 production Gaussian on the fixed three-torus, fixed positive rho floor, positive production Q_II, and any one fixed common real-even A7 regulator family with finite multiplier bound M_R, every deterministic spatial PSD L2 coefficient background obeys an exact det_2 identity and a cutoff-uniform Schatten-2 bound with the explicit M_R^4 factor. Consequently, when the B(Z) coefficient field and derivative carrier Y are independent production Gaussian copies, all fixed-p negative-exponential moments are uniformly finite and the product-space densities and projected finite-volume laws converge along the full sequence.
scope: CLOSED@INDEPENDENT-DERIVATIVE-PRODUCT-GAUSSIAN on L=16 for the A1 production covariance, three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, eta_shell=0, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and one fixed common real-even scalar regulator family with M_R<infinity. The executable constants instantiate M_R=1; the analytic theorem carries M_R^4. The self-coupled A7 action is outside this closure.
falsifier: A wrong det_2 sign or factor; omission of M_R^4 for a merely uniformly bounded regulator family; failure of the spatial Schatten convolution bound, B positivity or beta_B growth bound, sextic absorption, common-space second-chaos isometry, full-sequence density convergence, full-B Gaussian-divergence identity, parity-breaking negative control, self/decoupled scalar distinction, authority hash, PDF review contract, assertion count, or any primary, independent, or integrated check falsifies the pinned closure.
